weapon.d: Accelerates Special trigger (cooldown count-1). At start of combat, if unit's HP ≥ 25%, grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+5 to unit during combat, foe cannot make a follow-up attack, grants Special cooldown charge +1 per attack (only highest value applied; does not stack), and when unit deals damage to foe during combat, restores 7 HP to unit (triggers even if 0 damage is dealt).

special.d: Boosts damage by 50% of unit's Res.
Boosts damage by 50% of unit's Res.

a.d: Unit can counterattack regardless of foe's range.
Unit can counterattack regardless of foe's range. If foe initiates combat, grants Res+5 to unit during combat.

b.d: If unit's HP ≥ 90% and foe initiates combat, unit makes a guaranteed follow-up attack.
If unit's HP ≥ 80% and foe initiates combat, unit makes a guaranteed follow-up attack.
If unit's HP ≥ 70% and foe initiates combat, unit makes a guaranteed follow-up attack.
If unit's HP ≥ 25% at start of combat and foe initiates combat, reduces damage from foe's first attack during combat by 25% and unit makes a guaranteed follow-up attack.

c.d: Allies within 2 spaces gain: "If foe uses bow, dagger, magic, or staff, grants Def/Res+2 during combat."
Allies within 2 spaces gain: "If foe uses bow, dagger, magic, or staff, grants Def/Res+3 during combat."
Allies within 2 spaces gain: "If foe uses bow, dagger, magic, or staff, grants Def/Res+4 during combat."

Grants Def/Res+4 to allies within 2 spaces during combat against bow, dagger, magic, or staff foes. If unit is within 2 spaces of an ally and foe uses bow, dagger, magic, or staff, grants Def/Res+4 to unit during combat.
